''See also: [[Rippling Sword Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Rippling Sword is a [[Striker technique]] used by various combatants, most notably [[Yerin]]. When activated, the [[technique]] manifests as a wave of [[sword madra]] and [[aura]] that travels through the air. This energy often takes the form of a silver, crescent-shaped storm or slash that can cut through physical objects, magical barriers, and other [[sword]] techniques. Depending on the user and the specific application, the [[technique]] can appear as a silver-red wave of energy or a deadly crescent moon. It is capable of significant destructive force, such as slicing through the ground, splitting fire, or even devastating large areas like an entire island. The effectiveness of a Rippling Sword can vary based on the user's power; for instance, it has been described as being able to sever a creature's head or pass through spiritual entities without effect if the target is a phantom of [[Shadow|shadow]] and [[dreams]].}}
